instruction: Cinematic video still, medium shot. In an indoor studio with a plain backdrop, three friends dance under soft, colorful pink and blue lighting. In the center foreground, the blonde woman in the black halter dress (R3) dances with arms outstretched, head tilted back, singing joyfully. To her right, the woman with dreadlocks in the red fringed dress (R1) dances dynamically, looking down with a smile. In the left background, the man in the black vest and white t-shirt (R2) dances with bent arms, looking forward.
